We are live at Frieze Abu Dhabi!
Visit us at Booth A12 to experience a curated presentation featuring works by Farid Belkahia, Hédi Selmi, Hassan El Glaoui, Chaïbia Talal, and Sadok Gmach.

#modernart #friezeartfair #hediselmi #belkahia

Photo @sebastianopelliondipersano

As we enter a singular Autumn/Winter season, Le Violon Bleu Gallery is honoured to invite you on a curated journey across four major cultural capitals. 
Over the coming months, we will celebrate the legacy and avant-garde spirit of the Modern North African Masters pioneering figures who have permanently reshaped global art history.
Save the dates and see you at each step ⛳
